gold_provenance._comment: Authorship provenance for the gold/accuracy oracle (ROADMAP §4, ADR-3). The eval is only a real measurement when the gold set is authored INDEPENDENTLY of the corpus — otherwise accuracy is partly tautological (the oracle was written to match the data it grades). This file makes that status explicit and machine-checkable: no jurisdiction may be launch_cleared while independent_author is false.
gold_provenance.note: Co-authored with the seed corpus to exercise the harness mechanism. Replace with an independently-authored, expert-reviewed gold set (e.g. via a trans legal-aid partner) before launch. This is the OPEN P0 review-gate #2 in docs/STATUS.md.
